response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station_usage GROUP BY lunarstage
